exposure: SARS-CoV-2 mRNA vaccination status (vaccinated vs. non-vaccinated)
cohort: The study included 98 COVID-19-positive women with non-severe symptoms who were admitted for delivery between March 2021 and July 2022, consisting of 35 vaccinated and 63 non-vaccinated individuals.
finding: SARS-CoV-2 mRNA vaccination was associated with a lower incidence of increased focal perivillous fibrin deposits and avascular fibrotic villi in placentas of COVID-19-infected pregnant women, suggesting a protective effect on placental tissue.
mod_finding: The mode of delivery was the only differing obstetrical characteristic between groups, but it lacked clinical implications.
cross-section timing: Between March 2021 and July 2022, at the time of delivery
